items.difficulty_reason: The lemma describes the Picard group exact sequence for squishing a tangent vector (statement lines 3364-3372). The proof (lines 3374-3395) is complete: surjectivity from the birational-finite lemma, the units sequence with the Leray bound, the kernel identification, and the injectivity from scalar-valued regular functions. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: the same cohomological bookkeeping as the companion glueing lemma, correctly ordered.
